name: Mickey's Smokestack BBQ Carved Smoked Chicken Breast (Standalone)
whyItWorks: The #1 flare-safe protein at the Disney Treasure pool deck BBQ counter: tender carved white chicken breast meat.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel off the spiced outer skin and enjoy the tender white chicken breast meat with a white roll or Baked Mac & Cheese.
watchOuts: Remove the spiced/peppery outer chicken skin
